user.title: Set up Home Daily Report
user.description: Track selected entities, generate daily rollups, and optionally summarize them with Home Assistant AI Task.

data_description.included_device_ids: Optional. Leave empty to track all matching entities in the selected domains.
data_description.included_entity_ids: Optional. Select helper entities or any specific entities to always include.
data_description.excluded_entity_globs: Comma-separated entity glob patterns, such as sensor.time*,sensor.date*.
data_description.report_time: Local time to generate the daily report.
data_description.max_days: Number of days of rollups to keep.
data_description.enable_ai_summary: Send report rollups to Home Assistant AI Task when generating summaries.
data_description.ai_task_entity_id: Optional. Pick a specific AI Task entity.
data_description.notify_service: Select a common notification service or enter another service name.
data_description.sidecar_url: Optional. HTTP(S) base URL of the external analytics sidecar.
data_description.sidecar_token: Optional until the sidecar is enabled. Never include this token in logs or report attributes.
